Goldena City Gems Villas

Villa in Kamala
HomeSaleGoldena City Gems Villas

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

A small Goldena Group development of two-storey villas in Kamala on Phuket's west coast, each with a private pool. Units found are three-bedroom homes of about 150 sqm built on compact plots of roughly 140-170 sqm. Still under construction with a handover expected between 2027 and early 2028.

Goldena City Gems Villas: key facts

  • Goldena City Gems Villas is a duplex villa in Kamala, Phuket.
  • Units: 3 bedrooms, 150 sqm.
  • Construction status: under construction.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Leasehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿12,900,000.
  • Nearest beach: Kamala Beach (600 m (Aster of Asia listing) vs about 1 km (Aster of Asia text)).

Facilities & amenities

  • Swimming pool (private, per unit)
  • 24-hour security
  • Security cameras
  • Garden area
  • Balcony
  • Pet-friendly
